# Version 3.119.4
> **Expanded platform support** · Released May 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.4)

> **Supersedes [3.119.3](3.119.3.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands Linux, Tizen, GTK4, and .NET 10 support with targeted platform fixes. This stable servicing release also adds native hardening, updates bundled dependencies, and rolls up the unreleased 3.119.3 preview.

## Breaking Changes

- **Blazor _Imports is no longer a component** — The generated `SkiaSharp.Views.Blazor._Imports` type no longer derives from `ComponentBase` or implements Blazor component interfaces. Do not use this implementation detail as a component base class.

## API Surface

- **GTK4 drawing-area integration added** — Adds SkiaSharp.Views.Gtk4 for applications using GirCore.Gtk-4.0 bindings. ([#3527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Desktop, Android, and native loading fixes** — Fixes GTK4 Cairo assertions, Android SKGLView rendering after MAUI tab switches, Linux ARM64 dependencies, and systems without DirectX 12. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3562](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3562), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494), [#3633](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3633))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic, Tizen 64-bit, and .NET 10 support** — Adds Linux Bionic native assets, Tizen x64 and arm64 builds, a net48 target for Windows validation, and .NET 10 SDK workload alignment. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3619](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3619), [#3631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3631), [#3514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3514))

## Security

- **Native dependencies and binary safeguards refreshed** — Updates libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and libexpat and carries additional native binary mitigations into the stable release. — ❤️ [@sshumakov](https://github.com/sshumakov) ([#3723](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3723), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3458](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3458), [#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5

Carries forward the synchronized HarfBuzzSharp servicing updates with the modernized platform support.
